BNS-356.label: Criminal defamation
questions: What specific imputation was communicated and to whom?
Who is alleged to have been defamed?
What intention, knowledge or reason-to-believe is alleged?
Is there evidence relevant to truth, public good, good faith or other statutory exceptions?

BNS-78.label: Stalking
questions: What repeated following, contact or electronic monitoring is alleged?
Is disinterest or lack of consent alleged?
Does the alleged conduct fall within the provision's protected-person and conduct requirements?
Is any legally relevant justification or exception raised, and what evidence supports it?
Is the conduct linked to newsgathering, and are there independent harassment allegations?

BNS-196.label: Promoting enmity
questions: Which groups and legally relevant distinctions are identified?
What words, acts or communications are alleged?
How is promotion of enmity or disturbance of harmony alleged?
What contextual facts and relevant mental state are addressed?
How does the court apply relevant expression safeguards, if discussed?

BNS-152.label: Sovereignty, unity and integrity
questions: Which particular statutory prohibited conduct is alleged?
What specific expression or action is relied upon?
What purpose, knowledge or fault requirement is addressed?
What link is alleged between conduct and the prohibited result?
Is lawful criticism or dissent distinguished from prohibited conduct?

BNS-299.label: Deliberate malicious religious insult
questions: What religion or beliefs are allegedly targeted?
What specific words or acts are alleged?
What evidence is offered for deliberate and malicious intention?
What publication, artistic, reporting or other context is documented?

BNS-353-1.label: Statements conducing to public mischief (subsection 1)
questions: Which paragraph of subsection (1) is invoked?
What exact statement or electronic communication is alleged?
Where the invoked paragraph requires falsity, what evidence addresses it?
What statutorily relevant prohibited effect is alleged?

BNS-353-2.label: False/rumour reports promoting enmity (subsection 2)
questions: What statement, rumour or report is alleged?
Which groups and prohibited enmity effect are alleged?

BNS-221.label: Obstructing public servant
questions: Which public function was being discharged?
What specific obstructive conduct, beyond observation or reporting, is alleged?

UAPA-13.label: Unlawful activities
questions: Which section 2(o) unlawful activity is alleged?
What concrete speech, action, advocacy or association is relied on?
What role and fault are alleged?
Are other UAPA sections separately charged? Do not import their bail rules automatically.

IT-67.label: Electronic obscenity
questions: What publication or transmission in electronic form is alleged?
What allegedly obscene material is identified?
What was the accused person's role in publication or transmission?
Is the applicable first/subsequent conviction penalty scenario documented?

OSA-3.label: Official Secrets Act section 3
questions: Which branch of section 3 is invoked?
What defence, code, document, location or other material is alleged?
What relevant prejudicial purpose or other statutory fault is alleged?
Is publication/newsgathering involved and how is it distinguished from prohibited conduct?

OSA-5.label: Official Secrets Act section 5
questions: Which communication, receipt, retention or other limb is alleged?
What is the information and why does the provision apply?
What relevant fault and authorization facts are alleged?
How is any reporting connection described?

IT-66A.label: Struck-down provision (inactive)
questions: Is this an actual new charge, a historical reference or a metadata error?
When did the alleged invocation occur?
